name: Derive BIP39 Ed25519 key
description: Validate a secret-backed English BIP39 mnemonic, derive via PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA512 then hardened SLIP-0010, and store the 32-byte Ed25519 seed. Default path matches Convex/GetMine venue identity. GetMine install DID uses m/44/864/1/0/0. GetMine uses the empty passphrase.

mnemonic.description: Reference to your own secret holding an English BIP39 phrase: s/NAME. Another principal's secret is refused, since the derived key is stored where you can extract it. Full words required; case and whitespace are normalised. Never pass the phrase inline. Or a held mnemonic, by its ID (did:key, multibase or 0x account key) or as <did>/mnemonics/<id>: needs key/derive on it, and the derived key goes only into that holder's keyring.

passphraseSecret.description: Optional reference to your own secret holding a BIP39 passphrase (NFKD-normalised); omitted means empty. Another principal's secret is refused. Different passphrases produce different keys.

path.description: Any SLIP-10 path: m for master, or up to 255 non-negative 31-bit indexes. No restriction on purpose, coin type or path shape. Apostrophes are optional; all indexes are hardened. The default uses Convex's official SLIP-44 coin type 864.

name.description: Destination secret name (single name, not a path). Stored encrypted in the caller's user namespace.

overwrite.description: Explicitly replace an existing destination secret, or the label of a key already in the keyring. Otherwise collisions fail atomically.

keyring.description: Store the derived key in a keyring instead of a secret (give this or name): its private key can never be read.

label.description: Your own name for the key in the keyring.

secret.description: Secret reference; private material is never returned.

accountKey.description: Native 32-byte Ed25519 AccountKey; JSON renders it as a 0x-prefixed hexadecimal string.

did.description: Ed25519 did:key for this public key.

path.description: Effective derivation path with explicit hardened apostrophes.
